To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Big Data approach is the most suitable one for processing Big Data, and the most suitable one when the data are not relational and when the data are unstructured.

1) the Big Data approach has the best performance in terms of data processing; 2) the operational database approach is the most scalable and has the best availability, while the decision support database approach has a good availability and scalability, but it is not as good as the operational database approach; 3) in terms of data modeling and data analysis, the Big Data approach is the one that provides the best performance and scalability; 4) the Big Data technologies provide the best performance and the
Big Data technologies are the most appropriate for storing and processing large datasets, but the other two approaches are still useful for certain applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What are the differences between the three approaches in what concerns data modeling and data analysis?

the following aspects: (i) the evolution of database systems and data warehouses, (ii) the emergence of the Big Data paradigm, (iii) data modeling in Big Data and (iv) the data analytics process in Big Data.
the following question: “What are the main differences between data models and analytics in operational databases, data warehouses and Big Data technologies?”.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Big Data is not a technology or a product, but instead a set of techniques, tools and approaches that are able to provide a better way of storing, processing, analyzing and visualizing large datasets.
the Big Data technologies are not a replacement for operational databases or decision support databases.
, in order to deal with Big Data, the main difference between operational databases, data warehouses and Big Data technologies is not the data volume but rather the data variety.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Big Data technologies have the potential to be the future for data modeling and data analysis, but it is necessary to develop a set of techniques and algorithms that allow us to deal with the volume, variety and velocity of Big Data.

the Big Data technologies have been designed to overcome the limitations and shortcomings of traditional data storage and processing technologies, but they still have a long path to follow in order to achieve a more mature and stable state.
Big Data is not a new technology or a new paradigm, but rather an evolution of the existing technologies and approaches that are used to store, process and analyze data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, despite the fact that Big Data is a recent trend in the field, it is already being widely used and adopted by companies.
, in spite of the differences between these approaches and their main goals, the main concepts and the main challenges are the same.
Big Data technologies are not only able to store huge amounts of data in a cost-effective way, but also allow to analyze them in real time and to get valuable insights.
